text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health Capital Budget Variance for the nine months ended on September 30, 2021. As of September 30, 2021, Toronto Public Health spent $1,009.3 thousand representing 20.1 per cent of the 2021 Approved Capital Budget of $5,032.0 thousand. Similar to last year, projects planned for 2021 continue to be affected by the impact of COVID-19 on the availability of resources within Toronto Public Health and its partners.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (November 19, 2021) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
